pages.text: A coke oven is a $(item)square slice$() of oven blocks: as many blocks $(item)high$() as it is $(item)deep$(), and only $(item)one block wide$(). Think of it as a row of long chambers running back from the doors. $(li)Every block must face the $(item)same way$().

A block faces you when you place it, so place them all while looking at the future front. $(li)The $(item)controller$() is the $(item)bottom front$() block. Only the front column shows doors. $(li)Sizes go from $(item)1x1$() to $(item)6x6$() (the server setting cokeOvenMaxSize, 5 by default, sets the limit). $(li)Extra blocks above or behind a full-size square stay separate ovens.

Ovens placed side by side are separate machines, each with its own controller. To build a battery, put several slices next to each other.$(br2)The view shows a $(item)3x3$() oven facing south: three high, three deep.
